readerCopy.body: An offer becomes more powerful because each person sees their own hope reflected in it. A creative deal, relationship promise, purchase, or charitable appeal gathers support while the exact terms remain soft enough to preserve the fantasy. Venus makes the exchange desirable, while Neptune surrounds it with longing, beauty, and the belief that ordinary limits may not apply. Under the conjunction, value and projection become difficult to separate. The experience may feel extraordinary until money, time, or commitment forces everyone to name what they thought they were receiving.
